# White Canvas Events UK

> Family-run marquee hire, dry hire, décor & styling, and Memory Vault
> (video guestbook) service, based in Derby and covering the Midlands.

## What we do
- Full-service marquee packages — delivery, setup, styling, and collection
- Dry hire — structure-only marquee hire, self-managed, from £300
- Décor & styling — available standalone, no marquee required
- Memory Vault — signature video guestbook housed in a real converted vintage telephone box, available standalone or with any package

## Where we work
Based in Derby, covering Allestree, Mickleover, Chaddesden, Oakwood and Spondon locally, plus Nottingham, Leicester, Birmingham, Sheffield and the wider Midlands.

## Pricing
Dry hire (structure only), installation and collection included over a 7-day hire, delivery free within 20 miles of the Derby base:
- 4m x 6m — £300  | 4m x 8m — £350  | 4m x 10m — £400  | 4m x 12m — £450
- 6m x 6m — £400  | 6m x 8m — £450  | 6m x 10m — £500  | 6m x 12m — £550
- 6m x 14m — £600 | Larger sizes — price on quotation
Full-service styled packages start from £514; final price depends on size, styling and extras — see the price calculator on the site.

## Who we are
Family-run, owned and operated by Hanraj and Simone, based locally in Derby.

Phone / WhatsApp: 07472 314552
